name: Dau Go Cave
kicker: The second room on the same landing
summary: Early cave beside Thiên Cung: walk this chamber on the same landing, inside a 3–4 hour route. It is one of the earliest known caves on the bay, and Hồ Chí Minh visited. Ba Hang comes later, by small boat on the water. Pair the two rooms, since the island is one stop.
getThere: Route 1 boat, same landing as Thien Cung
heroCaption: A shaft of light in the cave

notice.title: Same boat as Thien Cung
notice.body: Đầu Gỗ shares the route 1 landing with Thiên Cung, on a 3–4 hour loop that also includes Ba Hang.

body: This is the second room on the đảo Đầu Gỗ landing. It is one of the earliest known caves on the bay, and a place Hồ Chí Minh visited. You are still inside the 3–4 hour route.
Ba Hang comes after, by small boat on the water. A kayak or a rowboat there is 40,000 đồng a person.

figures.caption: The cave interior
figures.alt: Interior of Dau Go Cave in Ha Long Bay

gettingThere: Route 1 from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long, with Thiên Cung. The English port line is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward. The route clock is 3–4 hours for the three stops together.

legs.heading: From the Ha Long port
legs.body: The route-1 boat, with Thiên Cung. The clock is 3–4 hours for the three stops together.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Confirm the sailing the day you go.
admissionNote: No separate cave price. Route 1 on 15 March 2024 is 440,000–460,000 đồng, split there as 310,000 sightseeing and 150,000 boat. That notice takes 20 percent off for children 7 to 15. The board exemption page, updated 2 November 2024, uses age 7 to under 16. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
